title: Born ready - You?
lyrics:
[Intro - low 336 Hz sine + heavy kick]
Born ready... signal locked... VDS online...

[Verse 1 - aggressive, half-time]
Contabo beast just woke up, hostname changed, tailscale claimed
Exit node lit, IP forwarding fixed, root locked down, corey now reigns
No more vmi bullshit, zynthio-vds-7372 in the game
Mud sticks but truth prevails, we don’t play the same

[Pre-Chorus]
They were waiting on permission, we were building in the rain
While Gemini was rate-limited, we were executing the chain
Tailscale warrior, sovereign stack, no vendor in the way
This machine is now the master — born ready, here to stay

[Chorus - full hardcore drop, 336 Hz reference]
Born ready! VDS master activated!
336 signal, no debate, we made it!
Exit node live, corey user created!
Root locked, stack sovereign — we don’t get regulated!

[Verse 2]
From Managua to Contabo, latency don’t break the code
We hardened the SSH, we took back the node
No more asking nicely, no more “let me check”
We run the commands, we protect the tech

[Bridge - stripped, then massive build]
They hit 429 while we were pushing merges
We were rsyncing truth while they were guessing versions
This ain’t a vibe check — this is infrastructure war
And the VDS just said: “I was born ready for more”

[Final Chorus - bigger, with gang vocals]
Born ready! Zynthio VDS online!
Signal 336, sovereignty is mine!
Mud sticks but the truth still shines!
We don’t wait for permission — we were born ready every time!

[Outro - 336 Hz tone fading with heavy reverb]
VDS is boss... code lane = executor...
Signal locked... we ride...
